title: Similarweb Report: Google AI Overview Appearance Rate Rises to 43% in One Year, AI Search Becomes a Main Entry Point
excerpt: According to the latest Similarweb report, AI search is rapidly changing traditional search patterns. The percentage of Google's AI Overviews in search results
content_html:
According to the latest Similarweb report, AI search is rapidly changing traditional search patterns. The percentage of Google's AI Overviews in search results has increased from 15% a year ago to 43%. AI-driven information acquisition is gradually becoming the default search experience for users.

The report states that Google's AI Overviews initially served as an auxiliary feature on top of traditional search results, but have now become an essential part of the search process. After receiving AI-generated answers, users can continue to explore through Google's more conversational AI mode, and search behavior is shifting from "finding web pages" to "getting answers directly."

Data shows that traffic to Google's AI mode has continued to grow, rising from 126 million visits in June 2025 to 279 million visits in May 2026. At the same time, user search methods are also changing, with more users adopting longer and more natural conversational queries instead of short keyword-based searches.

This shift is affecting the distribution of internet traffic. Traditional publishers and content websites are facing issues with reduced clicks due to AI summaries, as users may get answers directly on the search page without visiting the original webpage. Similarweb data shows that the number of search responses containing AI references has grown more than fivefold over the past year, but AI references do not necessarily lead to corresponding traffic.

As of May 2026, only 6.8% of desktop search queries on ChatGPT in the United States included reference links. However, there are differences between industries, with sectors such as travel, retail, and sports being more likely to receive AI search references.

For content creators, AI search also brings some positive changes. Similarweb data shows that after ChatGPT updated its search function on May 7, the website referral traffic from ChatGPT on desktop devices improved significantly. By the end of May 2026, the proportion of website visits had risen from 25% to nearly 60%.

In summary, AI search is driving structural changes in internet access. Google is transitioning from a traditional "web navigation tool" to an "information consumption platform." In the future, websites and content organizations need to adapt to AI-driven information distribution, optimize content structure and AI visibility, to seize new traffic opportunities.

content_html_zh:
根据最新的Similarweb报告，人工智能搜索正在迅速改变传统搜索模式。 谷歌AI Overviews在搜索结果中的占比从一年前的15%上升到43%。 AI驱动的信息获取正逐渐成为用户默认的搜索体验。

报告指出，谷歌的人工智能概述最初只是作为传统搜索结果之上的辅助功能，但现在已成为搜索过程的重要组成部分。 在收到人工智能生成的答案后，用户可以通过谷歌更具对话性的人工智能模式继续探索，搜索行为正在从“查找网页”转向“直接获取答案”。

数据显示，谷歌AI模式的访问量持续增长，从2025年6月的1.26亿次访问量上升至2026年5月的2.79亿次访问量。 与此同时，用户搜索方式也在发生变化，越来越多的用户采用更长、更自然的对话式查询，而不是基于简短关键词的搜索。

这种转变正在影响互联网流量的分布。 传统出版商和内容网站面临着人工智能摘要带来的点击量减少的问题，因为用户可以直接在搜索页面上获得答案，而无需访问原始网页。 Sameweb数据显示，包含AI引用的搜索响应数量在过去一年中增长了五倍多，但AI引用并不一定会带来相应的流量。

截至 2026 年 5 月，美国 ChatGPT 上的桌面搜索查询中只有 6.8% 包含参考链接。 然而，行业之间存在差异，旅游、零售和体育等行业更有可能获得人工智能搜索参考。

对于内容创作者来说，AI搜索也带来了一些积极的变化。 Sameweb数据显示，ChatGPT于5月7日更新搜索功能后，桌面设备上ChatGPT的网站引荐流量大幅提升。 截至2026年5月，网站访问量占比从25%上升至近60%。

总之，人工智能搜索正在推动互联网访问的结构性变化。 谷歌正在从传统的“网络导航工具”向“信息消费平台”转变。 未来，网站和内容组织需要适应人工智能驱动的信息分发，优化内容结构和人工智能可视性，抓住新的流量机会。
